methodological_limitation_note: Linear Regression treats the target as continuous, unbounded, and equidistant with homoscedastic errors. For an ordinal classification target (Low=0, Medium=1, High=2), standard Linear Regression may yield predictions beyond valid bounds (<0 or >2) and cannot model non-linear class decision boundaries or class imbalance as naturally as Ordinal Logistic Regression, Random Forests, or Gradient Boosted Decision Trees.
